g.text: W: same-target source episode + retained certificate. U: truthful other-target episode. C: no episode. Skill, tools and final oracle held constant.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #25313c

g.text: Two exposed tasks × 2 repeat/order IDs; unmatched model randomness. Packet lengths differ (313 / 356 words); this is explicit context provision, not autonomous retrieval or persistent learning.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #25313c

g.text: Positive Δ is worse. Different schedule hashes do not establish new arithmetic graphs or global novelty. All source/full-primary comparators are current-target quantities.
